name: iFlow CLI (心流)
invoke: delegate to the `waypost-<role>` subagent, or paste `waypost agents show <role>` into a new session
notes: iFlow's .iflow/ directory is documented as holding agents and commands folders alongside IFLOW.md, and iFlow CLI is from the Gemini/Qwen CLI family — so .iflow/agents/*.md is a well-founded guess, but the frontmatter fields are NOT documented anywhere I could reach. Only name and description are emitted; check them once against your version and override this entry if it wants more.
